Looking right in 2D doesn’t really mean the scene holds together in 3D. That's why we open-sourced BlenderWorld last week and wanted to give it a closer look here.

It’s a benchmark with 223 tasks where agents use Blender to build editable 3D scenes from text, images or video references. We evaluate the actual projects through scene inspection and renders from multiple viewpoints. Can a visual agent turn a real-world brief into a complete, editable 3D scene? BlenderWorld is here to evaluate that

You can grab the benchmark below (Links in the comment) and plug in your own 3D agent to see how it does
